module_summary: UART transmitter: a 4-state FSM accepts a byte via valid/ready, then shifts start bit, 8 LSB-first data bits and stop bit onto the serial line, paced by a baud divider.

anchors.name: n1_409
anchors.why: Idle/start/data/stop state register selecting serial line level and shift timing.

anchors.name: n5_b37
anchors.why: Transmit request valid; in idle loads byte into shift register and starts frame.

anchors.name: n2_c30
anchors.why: Ready to accept a byte, decoded from idle state.

anchors.name: n0_a36
anchors.why: 8-bit byte to transmit, loaded into shift register.

anchors.name: n6_14d
anchors.why: Serial TX line: low start bit, shift register LSB, high stop/idle.

anchors.name: n11_74d
anchors.why: Transmit shift register, shifted right each baud tick in data state.

anchors.name: n3_4bb
anchors.why: Baud divider counter, cleared in idle, wraps at CLK_DIV-1.

anchors.name: n12_2f4
anchors.why: Data bit counter; reaching 7 at baud tick moves FSM to stop.

anchors.name: n10_4a4
anchors.why: Baud tick clock-enable advancing FSM, shift register and bit counter.

anchors.name: n7_f2a
anchors.why: Busy level output while FSM not idle.

groups.name: TX FSM
groups.description: Frame sequencing start, data and stop bits; ready and busy decode.

groups.name: Baud generator
groups.description: Divides clock to per-bit tick enable.

groups.name: Shift serializer
groups.description: Loads byte, shifts LSB-first onto TX line, counts 8 bits.
